purpose: SK-01 parity table: every OpenAPI operationId, its canonical route, and the SDK method that serves it — or an explicit UNBOUND/LEGACY_ONLY disposition. Unsupported PDP capability is never advertised as a live API.

legacyServed.note: canonical operationIds whose equivalent function the SDK serves only through the legacy /api/v1/media/* compatibility routes; the canonical operation itself is not invoked

unbound.note: OpenAPI operations with no SDK method — honest UNBOUND, never advertised as implemented

legacyOnlySdkRoutes.note: SDK routes with no OpenAPI operationId — legacy compat only, not canonical contract

guards.everyOperationClassified: all 27 OpenAPI operationIds appear exactly once
guards.unboundNotAdvertised: no UNBOUND operationId route appears as a live SDK literal
guards.routeLiteralsClassified: every /api/v1 literal in operations.ts is classified
